question.text: A small ball of mass $m$ and density $\rho$ is dropped in a viscous liquid of density $\rho_0$. After sometime, the ball falls with constant velocity. The viscous force on the ball is :

solution.text:
$\mathrm{mg}-\mathrm{F}_{\mathrm{B}}-\mathrm{F}_{\mathrm{v}}=\mathrm{ma}$
$\mathrm{a}=0$ for constant velocity
$\begin{aligned}
& m g-F_B=F_v \\
& F_v=m g-v \rho_0 g=m g-\frac{m}{\rho} \rho_0 g=m g\left(1-\frac{\rho_0}{\rho}\right)
\end{aligned}$
